question: Can this PR be landed together with an operator-owned purge of legacy sticky-disk entries and immediate verification of the first bounded-key warmer run?
rationale: The code can prevent future unbounded growth, but it cannot create its new backing disks while the installation remains at the vendor’s 1,000-entry limit; the dashboard cleanup and rollout timing require maintainer access and intent.

options.title: Coordinate purge and rollout
options.body: Clear legacy PR/hash entries, refresh this branch against main, land it, dispatch the warmer, and verify successful v4 snapshot commits and consumer mounts.

options.title: Hold until capacity is available
options.body: Keep the PR open until an operator can perform the dashboard purge and first-run verification so the new keys do not immediately encounter the existing limit.

recommendation.title: Coordinate purge and rollout
recommendation.body: Clear legacy PR/hash entries, refresh this branch against main, land it, dispatch the warmer, and verify successful v4 snapshot commits and consumer mounts.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the documented project decision owner, have recent history on the affected CI action, and can coordinate the repository and Blacksmith operational steps.
